tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for agreeing to participate. I'd like to ask you some questions about your experiences with volunteering and community service. First, have you ever participated in any volunteer activities and if you do, how often do you volunteer?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您同意参与。我想问您几个关于志愿服务和社区服务经历的问题。首先，您是否参加过任何志愿活动？如果参加过，您多久做一次志愿服务？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you. Can you tell me about a charity effort or a donation drive that you have heard about that made an impact on where you live?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢。您能告诉我一个您听说过的、对您所在社区产生了影响的慈善活动或捐赠行动吗？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting, can you describe a public service project that you have been involved in or would like to participate in if you had the time?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。您能描述一个您参与过的、或者如果有时间您愿意参与的公共服务项目吗？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great, some people believe that volunteering should be a mandatory part of the school curriculum to help students develop a sense of community. Do you agree or disagree with this idea? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。有些人认为，志愿服务应该成为学校课程的必修部分，以帮助学生培养社区意识。您同意还是不同意这个想法？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
